findings.title: U2 3V3 buck: operating point outside every internal-compensation example, no Cff footprint
findings.claim: L2 is 3.3x and effective COUT is 0.4x the datasheet examples for internal compensation, so the loop has no published margin at this point.

evidence.ref: synthetic U2 datasheet rev A p.18

not_published.action: add Cff and comp RC footprints

findings.fix: Use the example L and COUT, add a DNP Cff footprint across R21 and an injection resistor.
findings.bench_test: Bode with 50 ohm injection in series with R21 at 5 mV, all load corners.

findings.title: U2 loop margin unknown at light load
findings.claim: Same loop as R1, raised again from the load-step check.

findings.title: U5 mode pin has a pull-up and a pull-down both fitted
findings.claim: The MODE0 strap sits near mid-rail, between VIL and VIH, so the latched interface mode is undefined.

evidence.ref: released BOM, R40 and R41 fitted

findings.title: R11 value makes U1 never enable
findings.claim: R11 is 10 ohm; with R10 at 100k the EN pin sees 1.2 mV at 12 V, far below the 1.2 V threshold.

findings.title: Reset low level through D2 at cold
findings.claim: VOL plus diode forward voltage at -40 C exceeds the memory VIL.

verification.notes: verifier used the wrong VF row; this example keeps it refuted on purpose

findings.title: C50 bulk capacitance on 5V derates below the regulator minimum
findings.claim: C50 22 uF 6.3 V 0603 keeps about 30 percent at 5 V bias.

findings.title: OSC_OUT is tied to ground through R5
findings.claim: Grounding OSC_OUT may load the oscillator.

findings.title: Sensor I2C lines have no pull-ups
findings.claim: No resistor to a supply on I2C1_SDA or I2C1_SCL; the bus never reads high.
